baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated state in yakun munfakkina is bounded by hatta and the arrival of al-bayyina.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse places covering, joined textual affiliation, and associated allegiance around F-K-K's image of opening a locked or interlaced thing. Read through that material pattern, the named configuration does not unfasten by itself; the arriving bayyina makes the covered matter manifest and supplies the release event.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication supplies the continuing pre-arrival state in which the configuration holds.
Covering and concealment supply the closed layer that the later disclosure must expose.
Joining one thing to another gives the Book-affiliation a materially assembled aspect within the held configuration.
Sharing and partnership supply mixed allegiance as another form of attachment.
Opening what is locked and separating what is interlaced provide the central release operation.
Coming and arriving make the release depend on an event entering the existing state.
Appearance and becoming clear supply the disclosure that opens the covered configuration.

changed_reading.before: The groups would not stop disbelieving until enough proof reached them.
changed_reading.after: The groups occupy a covered, interlocked configuration that does not open on its own; the arriving disclosure is an operative release event, not merely extra information.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Munfakkina and bayyina each carry separation imagery, while hatta makes the bayyina's arrival a boundary.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ahl and kitab encode belonging and enrollment, while shirk encodes participation. F-K-K can mean departure from a state, and B-Y-N can mean both clarity and separation after connection. The until-clause can therefore mark the point at which previously held affiliations become distinguishable and part, without asserting that every member accepts the evidence.

activation_trace.role: A community bound by closeness and belonging supplies the initial affiliation being tested.
Enrollment in a register or group sharpens Book-affiliation as a counted social category.
Participation in a shared relation supplies a second mode of group attachment.
Separation from a thing, together with the negated continuation idiom, makes non-departure the pre-threshold state.
Parting after connection supplies bayyina with a sorting effect alongside its evidentiary sense.
Becoming visible supplies the clarity by which the attached parties can be distinguished.

changed_reading.before: The evidence is expected to end a common error by producing agreement.
changed_reading.after: The evidence is a threshold that ends undifferentiated attachment and begins sorting; clarification may produce parting rather than consensus.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kitab, munfakkina, and bayyina converge on binding instrument, release, and evidentiary disclosure within the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: K-T-B can name a binding decree and, more distantly, a written manumission contract; F-K-K can release a pledge, captive, or neck. Their co-presence permits a juridical analogy in which the named parties remain under a registered or binding condition until a qualifying disclosure arrives and triggers adjudicable release.

activation_trace.role: A binding decree or judgment supplies the condition whose force requires formal resolution.
The written manumission contract supplies the exploratory documentary bridge between kitab and release.
Freeing a pledge, captive, or neck supplies the juridical release operation.
Arrival supplies the procedural threshold at which release can occur.
Disclosure by speech, writing, or sign supplies the evidentiary instrument that makes the condition resolvable.

changed_reading.before: Munfakkina simply means ceasing or leaving once proof appears.
changed_reading.after: The clause can be heard as a release formula: a binding condition persists until an evidentiary instrument arrives and makes formal unfastening possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bayyina is no longer only a clear proposition. Dispatch, a messenger, sequential recitation, written sheets, and removal of contamination make it an embodied and performed disclosure whose delivery can do the opening posited by the focus.

activation_trace.role: Opening a locked or interlaced thing anchors the effect that the performed disclosure is inferred to have.
Disclosing meaning by expression or sign anchors bayyina in communicative performance.
Messenger and message give the evidence a personal carrier and a transmitted commission.
Following in sequence makes disclosure an ordered recitative process rather than a static object.
Written sheets provide the material surface from which the disclosure is performed.
Purity as removal of stain qualifies the transmitting medium as cleared of contaminating admixture.

structural_cues: 98:2 immediately follows al-bayyina with an indefinite messenger from God who recites purified sheets, functioning as its concrete specification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence bayyina, messenger, recitation, sheets, and purification; I infer that this delivered performance is what acts on the locked focus configuration. A live alternative is that 98:2 only identifies the proof while its recitation has no special causal role.

changed_reading.before: A clear proposition arrives and supplies enough information to permit cessation.
changed_reading.after: The arriving bayyina is a dispatched person performing ordered recitation from purified written surfaces; disclosure acts through embodied delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The purified sheets contain plural writings, and Q-W-M describes those contents through uprightness and sustaining structure. This strengthens the documentary baseline: the disclosure carries norms that stand, support, and supply a measure against which the prior entanglement can be opened.

activation_trace.role: Binding decree or judgment anchors the possibility that kitab carries normatively effective contents.
Opening the interlaced state supplies the operation for which the upright writings become the inferred norm.
Plural binding writings supply operative prescriptions inside the purified sheets.
Uprightness and rectitude make the writings a standard that corrects a misaligned configuration.
Support and sustaining structure make those writings capable of holding a reordered life, not merely winning an argument.

structural_cues: The locative fiha makes the plural kutub contents of the purified sheets, and qayyima directly qualifies those contents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural writings characterized by Q-W-M; I infer that their upright and sustaining quality provides the norm that enables release from the focus configuration. A live alternative is that qayyima means simply sound or valuable, without a structural role in unfastening.

changed_reading.before: The evidence is a message whose clarity alone changes the situation.
changed_reading.after: The evidence is a purified carrier containing plural, normatively binding writings whose upright and sustaining content makes reordering possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence explicitly places division after the bayyina's arrival among recipients of the Book. T-F-R-Q actualizes the latent separation shared by F-K-K and B-Y-N, so the focus threshold is more plausibly a disclosure that ends undifferentiated attachment and precipitates accountable partition than a proof that mechanically produces consensus.

activation_trace.role: Departure from a state, or non-cessation under negation, anchors the focus as a pre-arrival non-separation.
Parting after connection gives the focus bayyina a latent partitioning capacity.
Becoming clear supplies the disclosure by which the ensuing partition becomes accountable.
Scattering into parts supplies the overt post-arrival realization of the focus's latent unfastening.
The written Book identifies the divided recipients with the textual affiliation already named in the focus.
After in contrast to before fixes division on the far side of the evidence event.
Coming and obtaining repeat the arrival threshold with the bayyina as subject.
Separation and parting make the repeated bayyina resonate directly with the reported division.

structural_cues: 98:4 repeats al-bayyina and the Book recipients from the focus.
The restrictive sequence places tafarraqa only after the bayyina had come to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated constituency, explicit after-sequence, arrival, and division; I align that direction with the focus's hatta threshold and infer that disclosure precipitates sorting. A live alternative is that 98:4 reports later sectarianism without glossing munfakkina in 98:1.

changed_reading.before: The proof arrives and ends dissent by making everyone agree.
changed_reading.after: The proof arrives and ends an undifferentiated condition by exposing differences; its immediate narrative effect can be division rather than consensus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command sequence supplies a practical path through the focus entanglement: submit, extract allegiance from admixture, incline toward one direction, establish an upright practice, and externalize it through giving and growth. Release is therefore not an automatic cognitive reflex to evidence but an enacted reconfiguration away from shared allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Shared partnership anchors the mixed allegiance from which the later exclusive orientation separates.
Opening and separating an interlaced thing anchor realignment as practical unfastening.
Obligating request makes the post-disclosure path commanded rather than automatic.
Worship as submissive obedience supplies the governing posture of the realigned configuration.
Exclusive separation from partnership directly supplies extraction of allegiance from admixture.
Obedience and willing submission make the purified orientation a lived regime.
Inclining toward a direction supplies deliberate turning away from the prior mixed relation.
Uprightness and rectitude supply the stable geometry of the newly established practice.
Giving turns the response outward as a transfer rather than leaving it at inward assent.
Growth and increase make the outward transfer productive within the reordered life.

structural_cues: The restrictive ma umiru illa construction narrows the required response, then coordinates devotion, prayer, and giving.
Mukhlisina and hunafa qualify orientation while yuqimu and yutu make that orientation enacted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive command, purified devotion, directional inclination, established prayer, and giving; I infer that these actions describe how the focus unfastening is realized. A live alternative is that 98:5 states independent duties after the evidence narrative rather than the mechanism of munfakkina.

changed_reading.before: Once the evidence arrives, recognition itself releases the named groups from their prior state.
changed_reading.after: The evidence discloses a commanded route of disentanglement: exclusive submission, deliberate turning, upright practice, and productive giving must enact the release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus constituency returns after the evidence sequence and is still marked by K-F-R, then placed in fire with K-H-L-D's permanence and clinging. This weakens any model in which hatta guarantees universal release: the arrival ends the undifferentiated pre-evidence condition by exposing and sorting, but it does not coerce every attachment open.

activation_trace.role: The branch's combination of separation and negated non-cessation anchors the ambiguity between release and continued state.
The hunter's snare supplies a contained image of an attachment that evidence can expose without mechanically undoing.
Continued covering or rejection of truth marks the repeated constituency by response after disclosure.
Kindled fire supplies the consequence-location of the attachment that remains unopened.
Stable duration resistant to passing away turns continued attachment into an enduring outcome.
Clinging and remaining attached mirror the focus's non-unfastening at the level of consequence.
Evil and harm supply the evaluative classification made possible after evidence has sorted responses.

structural_cues: 98:6 repeats all three identifying elements from 98:1: those who disbelieved, the People of the Book, and the associators.
The repeated group is now located and evaluated after the intervening evidence and command sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated designation, continued K-F-R, fire, and permanence; I infer continuity between pre-arrival non-detachment and a post-arrival attachment that remains for one response class. A live alternative is that khulud describes punishment only and should not be read as a semantic continuation of munfakkina.

changed_reading.before: Until the evidence comes implies that everyone named will then detach from disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The terminus marks exposure and sorting, not forced conversion; a disbelieving subset remains attached and that attachment becomes durably lodged in consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins from inherited or communal labels, but the paired outcome verses classify by trusted response and deliberate repaired action, then rank within all created beings. Bayyina therefore not only reveals content; it cuts across prior affiliations and makes a new response-based belonging visible.

activation_trace.role: Communal closeness and belonging anchor the inherited affiliation from which the focus begins.
Enrollment in a register or group supplies the old counted category that the response classification crosses.
Separation after connection anchors the evidence as a recutting of prior group boundaries.
Heart-settling trust supplies the inward response criterion of the new class.
Intentional action supplies the outward criterion that prevents classification by assent alone.
Soundness opposed to corruption makes the actions reparative rather than merely active.
Excellence and selection supply the positive rank generated by the response-based classification.
Creation and bringing forth widen the comparison beyond inherited religious constituencies to created beings.

structural_cues: 98:6 and 98:7 use parallel those-who clauses and the shared al-bariyya classification while contrasting disbelief with trust plus action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel outcome classes and shared creation-wide ranking; I infer that evidence recuts the focus's inherited affiliations according to response. A live alternative is that the believing class is adjacent to, rather than drawn from or across, the groups named in 98:1.

changed_reading.before: The focus addresses fixed religious communities and asks whether those communities leave their position.
changed_reading.after: The communal labels are starting attachments; after disclosure, trust and reparative action make a new class that cuts across inherited belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: F-K-K's release is given a positive destination rather than left as endless detachment. Recompense, nearness, cultivation, sheltered garden, continuous provision, widened flow, permanence, and mutual satisfaction form a stable reciprocal habitat. The old bond opens so that a responding person can be reattached within a life-giving order.

activation_trace.role: Release from pledge or bondage anchors the departure whose positive destination the final context supplies.
A tie connecting parties permits disclosure to end one attachment while making another relation visible.
Action met by fitting recompense supplies the reciprocal transition from response to destination.
Nearness and presence locate the released person within relation rather than in mere absence from the old state.
Cultivation, repair, and completion make the destination a maintained order.
A garden sheltered by trees supplies a protective habitat for the new attachment.
Continuing provision and giving make the habitat actively sustaining.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies an ecological counterpart to unfastening.
Stable persistence supplies permanence to the newly entered order.
Mutual satisfaction supplies reciprocity between the released people and God.

structural_cues: 98:8 moves from recompense and nearness through a flowing habitat to permanence and reciprocal satisfaction.
The closing sequence describes both durable place and durable relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reward, nearness, cultivated shelter, flow, permanence, and mutual satisfaction; I infer that this is the positive destination of the focus's release. A live alternative is that 98:8 is an independent reward description and does not specify the semantics of munfakkina.

changed_reading.before: Release means only stopping or leaving the former state.
changed_reading.after: Release opens an old bond so that responders can enter a cultivated, continuously supplied, permanent, and reciprocal relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from T-L-W to T-L-L rather than the morphology of yatlu itself. It remains valid as a packet-supplied branch echo anchored in the focus's F-K-K and communicative B-Y-N. Downstream prose must label it a kinetic analogy, not a lexical translation of recitation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs an arriving disclosure with opening what is locked or interlaced.

activation_trace.role: Opening the locked and separating the interlaced provide the focus operation receiving the kinetic echo.
Disclosure by expression anchors the kinetic image specifically to communicated evidence.
The non-dominant split branch's pouring and pushing supplies recitation with exploratory pressure against the locked configuration.

changed_reading.before: Recitation transports the content of an already complete proof.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained split-branch analogy, recitation can be imagined as a poured or pushing force that performs the opening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates hydrological senses of A-T-Y and reads later streams back into the focus. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit coming and unfastening, with packet-backed flow imagery in 98:8. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for transmission, not as the lexical meaning of tatiha.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bayyina comes to a configuration described by F-K-K's opening of what is locked.

activation_trace.role: Opening a blockage or interlacing supplies the channel-clearing operation.
A watercourse and clearing its way turn arrival into exploratory directed flow.
A torrent arriving from elsewhere supplies the force of an external influx into a closed locality.
Unhindered running and spreading provide a later packet echo of successful circulation.
Widening a passage until it flows supplies the completed material analogue of unfastening.

changed_reading.before: Evidence arrives as a discrete object delivered to passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, disclosure behaves like an incoming current that clears a blocked channel and replaces closure with sustained circulation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links K-F-R's covering with J-N-N's tree-covered garden, two morally opposite domains. It remains valid as a contrastive mechanism anchored in the focus's covering and clarification, with purification and garden shelter supplied by context. Downstream prose must call it a reversal of material imagery, not an equation of unbelief and garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from K-F-R's covering toward B-Y-N's becoming manifest.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the initial opaque enclosure.
Becoming visible supplies the discriminating transition rather than a simple rejection of every kind of cover.
Removal of stain supplies the distinction between contaminated concealment and a cleansed medium.
A garden concealed by trees supplies a later life-bearing and protective form of covering.

changed_reading.before: The movement is simply from covering to total exposure.
changed_reading.after: The disclosure differentiates destructive concealment from purified, life-bearing shelter: the problem is not cover as such but what the cover does.

strongest_changes: 98:2 turns an abstract proof into a sent, recited, purified performance.
98:4 strongly activates the focus's latent separation sense and blocks the assumption that arrival produces consensus.
98:5-98:7 shift release from automatic cognition to enacted exclusive response and response-based reclassification.
98:8 gives unfastening a positive destination in enduring flow, cultivation, nearness, and reciprocity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus unusually couples F-K-K's unlocking and release with B-Y-N's double capacity for clarity and separation. K-T-B adds binding and manumission imagery, while later division, practice, classification, and stable flow preserve several distinct readings instead of resolving them into one.
remaining_uncertainties: Munfakkina can foreground ceasing, departing, being released, or separating, and the omitted object leaves the exact attachment underdetermined.
The immediate relation of 98:2 to al-bayyina strongly suggests specification, but the degree to which recitation itself causes unfastening remains inferred.
The juridical, hydrological, covering-reversal, and non-dominant T-L-L activations are packet-grounded analogies rather than secure lexical glosses.
